anti_tuning_note: The comparator was written and adversarially tested before the commissioned delivery exists, which is what let it fail honestly. A frozen instrument that could not discriminate would have been worse than no instrument.
headline: Harmonic template matching cannot localize form in this recording, so the comparator was not frozen.

what_the_adverse_controls_caught_first.detail: 0.70 sliced through a legitimate range of 0.62 to 0.80, so every adverse variant and the untouched control failed identically -- the controls were indistinguishable from the real thing, which is the signature of a threshold measuring nothing.
what_the_adverse_controls_caught_first.repair: contrast against the file's own window-score distribution

what_the_adverse_controls_caught_first.detail: any nonzero best rotation was read as transposition, and a sparse template prefers some rotation by a hair almost everywhere.
what_the_adverse_controls_caught_first.repair: a rotation must beat rotation zero by a margin to count

what_the_adverse_controls_caught_first.detail: the two-semitone shift matched nothing, so there was no rotation evidence to object with, and tonal correspondence reported PASS for a transposed object.
what_the_adverse_controls_caught_first.repair: no criterion may pass when nothing was placed

what_the_instrument_needs.blocking_artifact: children_score_reconstruction.mid, together with the score extraction and MixScore, are path hints in the specimen and exist outside this checkout.
candidate_redesign: self-similarity structure on the audio side, matched against the score's repeat and D.S. pattern
texture, register and onset-density features, which is where this record's sections actually differ
score-side note density from the 1,257-note reconstruction MIDI, which is an external artifact not present in this checkout
what_the_instrument_needs.diagnosis: The score's structural claim is about recurrence -- bars 5-8 repeat, 10-17 repeat, the D.S. returns to 34-52 -- not about harmonic content. The audio side should therefore be matched on its own recurrence structure rather than on chord identity.

why.consequence: Any threshold that made these anchors match would be fitting noise. Freezing it would have produced authoritative-looking verdicts from a statistic with no discriminative power.
why.finding: Children is a four-chord loop. Its harmony is close to constant for seven minutes, so a harmonic template cannot tell one part of the record from another.

measured_on_the_control_candidate.note: Two unrelated bars chosen at random are already 0.887 similar. A best-window score of 0.79 is therefore below the background, not above it.

measured_on_the_score_side.note: The sheet declares eleven distinct harmonies for the whole form.
